task_title: Release runbook: remove unsupported --dry-run claim for release-cut-check.sh
task_criteria: docs/releasing.md no longer presents --dry-run as a supported release-cut-check.sh invocation: the dry-run-proof section states the versioned invocation scripts/release-cut-check.sh vX.Y.Z is the read-only pre-cut check and that the script accepts only a positional tag; verified by grepping docs/releasing.md for the removed flag phrasing

tests/test_release_workflow.py pins the documented behaviour: a test asserts scripts/release-cut-check.sh --dry-run exits 2 with the usage message naming the vX.Y.Z tag requirement, and the versioned pre-cut check is asserted read-only (no tree mutation across a run) and green; verified by .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_release_workflow.py -q passing
the full suite stays green (.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q, no new failures) and docs/releasing.md plus CHANGELOG.md document the change
the implementation commit carries a ch:trace line naming row=REVIEW-TJ-016 with spec, test and evidence paths
